title: Host detail
description: One host in depth: CPU, memory, disks, network, the containers and systemd units it runs, and its logs.

panels.title: Failed systemd units
panels.description: No data means node_exporter's systemd collector isn't on for this host.

panels.title: CPU by mode
panels.description: Share of total CPU capacity. iowait climbing means something is blocked on disk; steal means the hypervisor is oversubscribed.

panels.title: Swap used & memory pressure
panels.description: Sustained swap paging (right axis) is the clearer sign of memory pressure than swap used alone.

panels.title: Time until full (at the last 6h's rate)
panels.description: Only filesystems that are actually filling show up here. Empty is good.

panels.title: Disk busy
panels.description: Percent of wall-clock time the device had I/O in flight.

panels.title: Disk throughput
panels.description: Reads above the axis, writes below.

panels.title: Network throughput
panels.description: Received above the axis, transmitted below.

panels.title: Failed systemd units
panels.description: `systemctl --failed` on this host, as of now. Empty is good.

panels.title: Log lines by program
panels.description: From the central syslog receiver. Nothing here at all means this host isn't shipping logs (see the Monitoring health dashboard).
